MEASURED CONFLICT INSIDE THE PROFILE, RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF THE CHAPTER-SPECIFIC CLAUSE — recorded loudly for Agent 13. mahitiprad_gadya.md Avoid-2 states two tests under one hard heading: (a) an arithmetic proxy — 'in a dialogue-carried chapter, the number of topics is strictly less than the number of quoted speaker turns'; and (b) the substantive rule — 'no topic boundary falls at a change of speaker unless a fact-step also completes there'. In this chapter the quoted speaker turns number 7 and the topics number 10, so test (a) is inverted. Test (b) was checked boundary by boundary and holds at all nine boundaries. A2 surfaced this itself rather than hiding it, and this validator does not treat (a) as a block. Reason: the same profile's Explanation-unit section names THIS chapter and requires the opposite arithmetic — 'Where the prose walks a sequence, each stage is a topic … std-6 ch 5 moves પાવરહાઉસ → ગ્રિડ → ફીડર → ઘર', 'a turn that carries two stages is split at the stage, not at the quote mark', plus a frame-opening introduction topic and a frame-closing resolution topic, both named for std-6 ch 5. દાદાજીનો એક જ અવતરિત વળાંક six printed paragraphs and six fact-steps ચલાવે છે; splitting it at the stages is exactly what the profile orders, and it is the only reason topics exceed turns. Enforcing (a) here would force fewer than seven topics, i.e. would force fact-steps to be merged — the very error the Explanation-unit clause forbids. The chapter-specific clause governs the general proxy.

Boundary-by-boundary evidence for Avoid-2 test (b). Speaker actually changes at three boundaries only, and a fact-step completes at each: T1/T2 (narrator + દાદાજીની પ્રસ્તાવના → દાદાજીનું પતંગ-દૃષ્ટાંત; the fact-step 'why the telling happens' completes), T2/T3 (દાદાજી → રામુ; the ઝાટકો દૃષ્ટાંત completes), T8/T9 (દાદાજી → છોકરાં; the શહેરનાં કામની યાદી completes). The boundaries T3/T4, T4/T5, T5/T6, T6/T7 and T7/T8 all fall INSIDE one unbroken quoted turn and are cut at fact-stages, never at a quote mark. At T9/T10 the speaker does not change at all — both are દાદાજી. No boundary anywhere in the plan falls at a speaker change without a fact-step completing there.
